senses.gloss:
Goṇa
or zoNa scholar in Prābhākara Mīmām3sā; son of Umāpati an. father of Nārāyaṇa (a. of C. Chandogapariśiṣṭaprakāśa on Karmapradīpa. Dacca 4092. IO. 450).
See NCC. II. p. 391a an. III. p. 204a.

Goṇikāputra
or goNIputra ancient authority on Kāmaśāstra. mentioned by Vātsyāyana in Kāmasūtra, I. i. 16 a. a. of a work on Pāradārika section an. also ref. to in that section of Kāmasūtra, V. i. 8; by Kokkoka in Ratirahasya (Taraporewala edn. p. 2; see also Intro. p. v.); in Pañcasāyaka, IO. 1237.

Goṇikāputra
authority on gr.
Q. by Patañjali in Mahābhāṣya under I. iv. 51.

Goṇṭiśarman
or goNDIzarman(mizra) son of Harapati; protege of King Vāsudeva, son of Ravikara of Mithila; defeated Pandits of the court of King Rāmabhadra.
--Śūdrācāra (vivekapaddhati) in 3 pts. Mithilā I. 386 (ms. d. 1611 A. D.). Rep. Hpr. 1895-1900, p. 15.
See Kane, HDS. I. p. 693a.
